description: Training agents that honor robots.txt are disallowed and ai-train=no is signaled; agents that do not honor it are left to the engine.
policy:
# Posterna policy: the allow-list template.
#
# Agents that fetch pages to train AI models are blocked; everything else is
# allowed. It starts in monitor mode, so nothing is blocked until you change
# mode to enforce. The reference for every key is docs/policy.md in the
# posternahq/posterna repository.

version: 1
mode: monitor

# By verdict class. People are always allowed and are not configured here.
defaults:
  verified: allow
  declared_unverifiable: allow
  claimed_failed: allow
  unknown_automation: allow

# Verified search engines are never blocked or throttled.
guards:
  search_engines: protect

# Applies to every operator.
purposes:
  training: block

# What `posterna robots` prints, for you to copy into your own robots.txt.
# Posterna never serves robots.txt itself.
emit: [robots.txt, content-signals]
expected:
# robots.txt written by Posterna from agents.yaml.
# Crawlers that honor robots.txt are asked to stay out of what the policy blocks.
# The site's policy engine enforces against agents that do not.
# Content-Signal lines state how content may be used: https://contentsignals.org/

User-agent: *
Content-Signal: ai-train=no
Allow: /

# Training
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /
